metrics.name: processed_fps
metrics.formula: processed_frame_count / measured_elapsed_seconds

metrics.name: inference_fps
metrics.formula: completed_authoritative_inference_count / measured_elapsed_seconds

metrics.name: source_read_to_render_ms
metrics.formula: (render_complete_monotonic_ns - frame_packet_timestamp_ns) / 1000000

metrics.name: source_read_to_display_submit_ms
metrics.formula: (post_cv2_imshow_monotonic_ns - frame_packet_timestamp_ns) / 1000000

metrics.name: sensor_to_photon_ms
metrics.formula: external synchronized sensor stimulus to measured emitted display light

metrics.name: stage_duration_ms
metrics.formula: (stage_end_monotonic_ns - stage_start_monotonic_ns) / 1000000; stage dimension is required

metrics.name: mask_age_ms
metrics.formula: (current_frame_timestamp_ns - authoritative_mask_frame_timestamp_ns) / 1000000

metrics.name: processed_frame_count
metrics.formula: count of frames completing render in the measured interval

metrics.name: dropped_capture_frame_count
metrics.formula: count of capacity-one capture mailbox overwrites

metrics.name: dropped_inference_frame_count
metrics.formula: count of capacity-one inference mailbox overwrites

metrics.name: degraded_frame_rate
metrics.formula: degraded_frame_count / processed_frame_count

metrics.name: rss_mib
metrics.formula: resident_or_working_set_bytes / 1048576

metrics.name: latency_continuous_growth_flag
metrics.formula: true when six consecutive 50-second source_read_to_render_ms window medians strictly increase and Q6-Q1 > max(20 ms, 0.10*Q1)

metrics.name: rss_continuous_growth_flag
metrics.formula: true when six consecutive 50-second RSS window medians strictly increase and Q6-Q1 > max(8 MiB, 0.05*Q1)

metrics.name: basic_color_accuracy
metrics.formula: correct level-one basic-family predictions / evaluated cases

metrics.name: extended_color_accuracy
metrics.formula: correct allowed level-two display labels / evaluated cases

metrics.name: lighting_label_stability_rate
metrics.formula: physical samples retaining one level-two label across neutral, warm, and low lighting / samples evaluated in all three conditions

metrics.name: uncertain_output_rate
metrics.formula: cases emitted as uncertain / evaluated cases

metrics.name: forced_low_evidence_label_count
metrics.formula: count of cases below frozen evidence gates that expose a confident level-two label

metrics.name: color_name_margin
metrics.formula: best normalized color-name score minus second-best normalized color-name score; heuristic, not probability

metrics.name: segmentation_iou
metrics.formula: intersection pixel count / union pixel count; empty-empty is NOT_APPLICABLE

metrics.name: segmentation_adequacy_rating
metrics.formula: manual 0-3 adequacy rating with recorded reason

metrics.name: segmentation_adequate_rate
metrics.formula: standalone cases with adequacy rating >= 2 / evaluated standalone cases

metrics.name: automatic_mask_available_rate
metrics.formula: standalone cases producing a non-empty automatic garment mask / evaluated standalone cases

metrics.name: dominant_color_correct_rate
metrics.formula: standalone cases whose original corrected dominant color matches the declared reference / evaluated cases

metrics.name: manual_roi_completion_seconds
metrics.formula: monotonic elapsed seconds from explicit manual-selection start to accepted ROI

metrics.name: fullscreen_toggle_success
metrics.formula: requested fullscreen transition is confirmed by window state or manual recorded observation

metrics.name: viewport_aspect_ratio_error
metrics.formula: absolute(displayed_viewport_aspect/source_frame_aspect - 1)

metrics.name: processing_resolution_changed_flag
metrics.formula: true when fullscreen presentation implicitly changes capture or model processing resolution

metrics.name: text_overflow_count
metrics.formula: count of rendered text/card bounds outside their allocated presentation rectangles

metrics.name: delta_e_original
metrics.formula: CIEDE2000 distance between the original corrected color pair

metrics.name: delta_e_cvd
metrics.formula: CIEDE2000 distance between the selected-profile simulated pair

metrics.name: risk_score
metrics.formula: configured relational risk heuristic for the selected profile and severity

metrics.name: recolor_applied
metrics.formula: whether the selective recolor passed risk, improvement, severity, containment, and stability gates

metrics.name: severity_response_consistency_rate
metrics.formula: adjacent severity steps whose confusing-pair risk does not decrease beyond numerical tolerance / evaluated adjacent steps

metrics.name: spatial_risk_valid_pixel_rate
metrics.formula: finite in-range spatial-risk pixels inside the evaluated garment mask / garment-mask pixels

metrics.name: spatial_risk_outside_mask_pixel_count
metrics.formula: count of nonzero spatial-risk pixels outside the garment mask

metrics.name: spatial_risk_runtime_ms
metrics.formula: spatial risk map completion timestamp minus start timestamp

metrics.name: test_pass_count
metrics.formula: pytest passed test count from the release invocation

metrics.name: test_fail_count
metrics.formula: pytest failed plus error test count from the release invocation

metrics.name: privacy_default_saved_frame_count
metrics.formula: camera/video frames persisted during a default run without explicit artifact-saving opt-in

metrics.name: fatal_error_count
metrics.formula: unhandled fatal errors across the frozen release scenarios

metrics.name: artifact_checksum_mismatch_count
metrics.formula: available artifact bytes whose SHA-256 differs from the manifest

metrics.name: unconsented_tracked_media_count
metrics.formula: tracked personal-media artifacts without documented consent
